hero.title: Summer Courses in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: **Summer Courses in Mauritius** offer students, young adults and working professionals the opportunity to acquire new skills, explore academic interests and gain practical experience during a short break from regular studies or work. These courses can span from technology and business to communication, languages, design, tourism and professional development, depending on the institution and the program. **Summer Courses in Mauritius** are suitable for learners who want to develop practical knowledge without enrolling in a full-time degree. The available **summer short courses in Mauritius** can help learners explore different subjects and build skills for their academic or professional goals.

overview: The University of Mauritius publishes a list of short courses every year for learners wishing to attend in 2026\. The Institute of Technical Education and Technology (ITET) has also launched a summer short-course program from November 10 to December 18, 2026\.

universities.name: Institute of Technical Education and Technology (ITET)

faq.question: What is the 2026 summer course in Mauritius?
faq.answer: ITET has announced Summer Short Courses from 10th November to 18th December 2026\. Other providers may offer short courses at other times of the year. Students interested in summer short courses in Mauritius should check the official announcements for current schedules.

faq.question: Is summer course in Mauritius free of cost?
faq.answer: Some are. The ITET Summer Short Courses announced for 2026 are reported as free. University and private-provider courses may charge tuition or registration fees. The summer course fees in Mauritius depend on the provider and selected program.

faq.question: Who may apply for summer courses in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Eligibility is program specific. The announced ITET courses are targeted at the 16+ age group which includes students, job seekers, young adults and working professionals. Applicants should review summer course eligibility in Mauritius before registering.

faq.question: What are the subjects I can study at summer courses in Mauritius?
faq.answer: You can choose between communication, cybersecurity, graphic design, computer assembly, emerging technologies, smart agriculture, AI, project management and technical design software. Availability depends on provider and schedule.

faq.question: Do I get a certificate after finishing a summer course?
faq.answer: ITET announcement reads, “Participants of the above summer short courses will be issued a certificate. Other program certificate arrangements are at the discretion of the individual provider.” Summer Courses in Mauritius provide an opportunity for students, young adults and working professionals to explore new subjects and develop practical skills. Before applying, compare the course content, duration, eligibility, fees and certificate arrangements. Learners considering summer course admission in Mauritius should always check the latest information with the institution. With suitable planning, summer courses in Mauritius for international students can also offer an opportunity to explore short-term learning options while developing academic and professional interests.
